title: Assessment of functional alternatives to fluorinated foam blowing agents in insulation materials
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,928-940
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00751H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Romain Figuière, Olivier Kirik, Rahul Aggarwal, Gregory Peters, Ian T. Cousins
We use a multi-criteria assessment method (“multi-attribute utility theory”) in an assessment of non-chemical alternatives to fluorinated gases used in expanded insulation foams, considering multiple technical and environmental impacts aspects.
